name: cody
label: Cody
description: AI assistant trained on your business knowledge: bots, conversations and knowledge-base documents.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Visit your Cody AI API Keys page to retrieve the API key.

create_document_from_text.label: Create Document From Text
create_document_from_text.description: Upload text content to create a new document within the Cody knowledge base.

name.label: Document Name
name.description: The name or title of the new document.

content.label: Content
content.description: The text or HTML content to be added to the document. Max 768 KB.

send_message.label: Send Message
send_message.description: Send your message and receive the AI-generated response.

content.label: Message
content.description: The message to send to the conversation. (Max 2000 characters)

create_conversation.label: Create Conversation
create_conversation.description: Creates a new conversation with a bot.

name.label: Conversation Name
name.description: The name for the new conversation.

document_ids.label: Document IDs (Focus Mode)
document_ids.description: A list of document IDs to limit the bot's knowledge base for this conversation.

list_bots.label: List Bots
list_bots.description: List or search the bots in the Cody workspace.

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.description: A name keyword to filter bots by (case-insensitive partial match). Leave empty to list all bots.

list_conversations.label: List Conversations
list_conversations.description: List or search conversations in the Cody workspace.

bot_id.label: Bot
bot_id.description: The bot to list conversations for. Leave empty to list across all bots.

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.description: A name keyword to filter conversations by (partial match). Leave empty to list all.

get_conversation.label: Get Conversation
get_conversation.description: Retrieve a single Cody conversation by its ID.

includes.label: Includes
includes.description: Comma-separated related data to embed in the response. One or more of: 'document_ids', 'messages'.

update_conversation.label: Update Conversation
update_conversation.description: Update a Cody conversation (full replace of name, bot, and focus documents).

name.label: Conversation Name
name.description: The conversation name. Required (full replace): re-send the current name if you only want to change the bot.

bot_id.label: Bot
bot_id.description: The bot for the conversation. Required (full replace): re-send the current bot if you only want to rename.

document_ids.label: Document IDs (Focus Mode)
document_ids.description: A list of document IDs to set as the focus-mode documents for this conversation (full replace). Re-send the current focus documents (from Get Conversation) to keep them; leaving it empty may clear focus mode. List Documents gives the IDs.

delete_conversation.label: Delete Conversation
delete_conversation.description: Permanently delete a Cody conversation by its ID.

list_messages.label: List Messages
list_messages.description: List the messages in a Cody conversation.

conversation_id.label: Conversation
conversation_id.description: The conversation whose messages to list.

per_page.label: Per Page
per_page.description: The number of messages to return per page.

get_message.label: Get Message
get_message.description: Retrieve a single Cody message by its ID.

message_id.label: Message ID
message_id.description: The ID of the message to retrieve, as List Messages gives it.

includes.label: Includes
includes.description: Comma-separated related data to embed in the response.

list_folders.label: List Folders
list_folders.description: List or search the knowledge-base folders in the Cody workspace.

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.description: A name keyword to filter folders by (partial match). Leave empty to list all folders.

per_page.label: Per Page
per_page.description: The number of folders to return per page.

get_folder.label: Get Folder
get_folder.description: Retrieve a single Cody knowledge-base folder by its ID.

name.label: Name
name.description: The name of the new folder.

name.label: Name
name.description: The new name for the folder.

list_documents.label: List Documents
list_documents.description: List or search documents in the Cody knowledge base.

folder_id.label: Folder
folder_id.description: The folder to list documents from. Leave empty to list across all folders.

conversation_id.label: Conversation
conversation_id.description: The conversation to list the focus-mode documents of.

keyword.label: Keyword
keyword.description: A name keyword to filter documents by (partial match).

per_page.label: Per Page
per_page.description: The number of documents to return per page.

create_document_from_webpage.label: Create Document From Webpage
create_document_from_webpage.description: Scrape a web page URL into a new Cody knowledge-base document.

url.label: URL
url.description: The full URL of the web page to scrape, including protocol, e.g. 'https://example.com/page'.

folder_id.label: Folder
folder_id.description: The folder to create the document in.

get_document.label: Get Document
get_document.description: Retrieve a single Cody knowledge-base document by its ID.

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The ID of the document to retrieve, as List Documents gives it.

delete_document.label: Delete Document
delete_document.description: Permanently delete a document from the Cody knowledge base.

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The ID of the document to permanently delete, as List Documents gives it.
